description:
When sender and receiver are the same process nothing has to leave the heap. The BEAM special-cases this in erts_send_message with a data-less message struct. fz pushes the sender's own reference onto its mailbox (already a GC root) and copies nothing.

The runtime does not publish the spine. Investigation (fz-a9y.2 builder, probes in scratch a9y/t2/probe): every program that keeps a name for the sent list's cells past send(self(), xs) has that argument marked OwnershipMode::Share by construct_call_ownership (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs:3866; values_overlap at :3786, unknown origins count as overlap) and published before the call on native (src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs:1486 share_native_value) and on the interpreter (src/ir_interp/backend.rs:910 publish_backend_capture). The alias bit set there is what refuses the in-place rewrite; the Rewrite permission itself is granted inside the callee. Separating pair k0/k: identical programs except for the send, list_retention hits 2 vs 1. A runtime publication would be a second implementation of the question the compiler already answers, so it is not built.

Fixture: a list is sent to self, an alias is rewritten in place by a construction that holds Rewrite permission, the message is received intact; a control alias of an unsent list in the same program rewrites successfully. The fixture asserts the send-path list_cons allocation delta is 0 and the list_retention attempts/hits that separate the control from the sent case, on all three paths.

Done when:
- deep_copy_self_send_ref_for_aot (runtime/src/aot_shim.rs) and the JIT and interpreter self-send copies are deleted; the raw-pointer aliasing of one heap as both source and destination is gone; the three paths share sched::self_send.
- Fixture README, .agent/docs/any-value.md, .agent/docs/pattern-matching.md and guides/memory.html state the present-tense fact and name the compiler rule.
- Full gate green; pins reported, not edited. Commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer.
title: A self-send is a mailbox push
